title: Authoring UI: imported button instance on() handler not shown in Actions panel
description:
FIXED. Root cause: the Actions panel only surfaced (a) frame scripts, (b) a selected MovieClip instance's clipActions, and (c) a selected button SYMBOL's library-level buttonActions. It never read a selected button INSTANCE's on() handlers (SymbolInstance.buttonHandlers) — the field the Flash 8 importer populates from on(release){...} blocks. So an imported on(release) handler was in the model + compiled into DefineButton2, but invisible/uneditable in the UI.

CHANGES (packages/authoring-ui ONLY):
- ActionsPanel.tsx: added a new 'Actions - Button' INSTANCE mode driven by new props selectedButtonInstance + onButtonHandlersChange. It lists the on() events, shows the script for the selected event, and edits persist via the callback. This mode takes precedence over the symbol-level button mode (selecting a button instance on stage edits that instance's handlers, matching Flash 8). Exported pure helpers getButtonHandlerScript / updateButtonHandlerScript / buttonHandlerEventKey (keyPress-aware, order-preserving, empty-script removes handler, non-mutating).
- Shell.tsx: added selectedButtonInstance useMemo (selected display object is an instance of a button symbol) and handleButtonHandlersChange (persists via handleUpdateInstance -> updateDisplayObject, same path as clipActions). Wired both into <ActionsPanel>. Imported ButtonHandler type.

TEST: added src/__tests__/actionsPanelButtonInstance.test.ts (12 tests): pure-logic helper tests + a real react-dom/jsdom render test that mounts <ActionsPanel> with a button instance carrying on(release) gotoAndPlay("game"), asserts the script shows in the editor, and that typing a new script fires onButtonHandlersChange with the updated handler list.
